description: This file defines a React component 'AnimalSelectionPage' that renders a page allowing users to select an animal species. It displays a set of animals, with only 'Giant Anteater' enabled, and handles navigation upon selection.

methods.name: AnimalSelectionPage()
methods.description: React functional component that renders the animal selection interface and manages navigation and user interaction.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on animal cards; for active animals, stores the selected species in local storage and navigates to the dashboard.
